scope: Matched 13 PCM conditions from lecture-material-hints-20261020; not new independent speech sources. Off vs native Silero empty-only gate vs single first/last speech envelope with1000ms margin; no internal silence removal. Same3 vocabulary conditions. Reverse-selected3 SIL consistency repeat, not held-out validation.
metrics: NFKC lowercase letters/numbers character edit alignment, not semantic hallucination/omission counts. Literal global term counts are not occurrence-aligned accuracy. Empty lexical references report output chars, no CER.

preservation.scope: Only fixed source/input hashes checked; app vault not opened by benchmark, installed app not rebuilt/restarted by benchmark.

limitations: 2 technical talks/slides with human-postedited automatic captions, not perfect verbatim gold or full university lectures.
Only labeled respondent intervals from3 Seoul Corpus interviews; not whole overlapping conversation CER.
Office/cafeteria are derived mixes of genuine environment noise; not newly recorded on-site noisy lectures.
Every original speech chunk has positive VAD, so no estimate of natural VAD-missed speech loss.
Fixed30s diagnostic boundaries differ from installed quiet_cut app segmentation.
Timing excludes precomputed VAD and one model load; no general speed claim. Background resource load is uncontrolled.

product_integration.scope: Current product functions with3 original SIL PCM inputs in isolated QA DB; initial empty transcript seeded, not first-pass Whisper test; no installed app interaction or microphone. Manual Qwen runs actual installed model worker.

adoption.reason: Only empty-snapshot deferral demonstrated suppression without speech-content changes; manual bypass retained; no gain from envelope trimming.

regression.initial_error_cause: PermissionError on two existing loopback bind fixtures; full suite rerun with local socket permission passed
